technology_name: A ROBOTIC EXOSKELETON DEVICE FOR WRIST HAND REHABILITATION AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Wearable Assistive Exoskeleton / Physical Therapy Gear
problem_solved: Standard neurological stroke or trauma rehabilitation devices focus purely on single-joint finger motions, failing to assist coordinated multi-axis wrist supination and pronation movements.
description: A therapeutic wearable robotic exoskeleton device comprising a rigid forearm brace, a custom hand plate, a multi-axis wrist hinge assembly, and an integrated dual-drive motor controller to provide customizable multi-degree-of-freedom flexion guidance.
applications: Clinical physical therapy units, post-stroke motor rehabilitation centers, home care assistive devices, and neuromuscular research engineering labs.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
